headline: Executive order creates a new job category called Schedule F within the part of the federal workforce known as the excepted service.
what_it_does: This order sets up a new category of federal jobs called Schedule F. It places this category in the excepted service, which is the part of the federal workforce whose jobs are filled outside the standard competitive hiring process. Only the title was provided, so details are not available here, such as which jobs would be moved into Schedule F or what rules would apply to them.

who_it_affects.how: Employees whose positions are placed in the new Schedule F category could fall under different hiring and employment rules than jobs in the standard competitive service.
Agencies would have a new job category available within the excepted service for certain positions.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 21, 2020; the title alone does not state an effective date.
